# Montenegro · Field Notes

> Explore Montenegro from the Adriatic coast and Bay of Kotor to Lake Skadar and the rugged northern highlands, with scenic drives, old towns, mountain walks and local food. Personal six-day self-drive trip plan for two travelers, 01—06 October 2026: Runolist Chalet · Žabljak (3 nights, Oct 1–3), then Conte Hotel & Restaurant · Perast (2 nights, Oct 4–5).

The app at https://oriashkenazi.github.io/montenegro-2026-field-notes/ renders its content with JavaScript. The complete plan as plain text is at the link below; read it to answer questions about this trip.

## Trip plan

- [Complete trip plan](https://oriashkenazi.github.io/montenegro-2026-field-notes/trip.md): every day's timetable, drives, food and provisions, stays, insurance, budget, emergency numbers, all map waypoints and sources (132 KB Markdown)
- [Same content, llms-full.txt](https://oriashkenazi.github.io/montenegro-2026-field-notes/llms-full.txt)

## Raw data

- [itinerary.json](https://oriashkenazi.github.io/montenegro-2026-field-notes/itinerary.json): source data for the timeline, food, stays, insurance and budget
- [waypoints.json](https://oriashkenazi.github.io/montenegro-2026-field-notes/waypoints.json): map places with coordinates

## Days

- Day 1 · Thu · Oct 1: Tivat → Nikšić break → Runolist Chalet / northbound mountain transfer
- Day 2 · Fri · Oct 2: Black Lake / P14-Sedlo / Trsa / Plužine and Piva
- Day 3 · Sat · Oct 3: Tara bridge viewpoint, Biogradska Gora and Kolašin
- Day 4 · Sun · Oct 4: Runolist → Nikšić coffee → Risan mosaics → Perast bags secured → Kotor Old Town
- Day 5 · Mon · Oct 5: Kotor espresso / Njegoš Mausoleum / Kuk coaster / Skadar boat circuit
- Day 6 · Tue · Oct 6: Perast → TIV / rental return / flight home
